title: Deborah
textBlocks:
Brave Wise Deborah
Hello Bravehearts
in today’s Bible story 
You will see that God forgives the Israelites again
and He rescues them from a bad King.
Meet all the characters in today’s true Bible story

Meet Deborah 
Deborah is a prophet 
and a judge
She has been sitting under palm trees 
helping people solve there problems

Deborah hears from God and she leads the Israelites into battle against the bad King.
Others were afraid but she wasn’t because she TRUSTED GOD

The people were scared because this King had 900 chariots made from strong iron
(the Israelites didnt have these strong chariots)

But God helped them fight the iron chariots with……
WATER!

Yes He opens the heavens and lots of rain poured down and the chariots got stuck in the mud

Let us make PALM TREES like the ones Deborah sat under
YOU WILL NEED
An Empty Toilet Roll
Green paper
Brown paint and kokis
and your imagination
